review_notes: I read the whole file and searched for its uses in the formal-frontier sheaf-cohomology library. The file has no simp or reassoc attributes at all. The only lemma that fits a canonical simp or reassoc interface is the colimit-leg lemma `colimit_ι_nativeGlobalSectionsComparison`. The factorization theorem `nativeGlobalSectionsComparison_eq_colimMap_post` is a def-expansion identity whose RHS is larger, so it should not be simp, and I did not flag it. I did not run Lean, so the proposed `@[reassoc (attr := simp)]` is untested. Two uncertainties remain: whether the `reassoc` generator copes with the lemma's explicit arguments, and whether `simp` would unify the instance-dependent `colimit.ι` terms at the downstream call sites. I only compared this lemma with Mathlib's `colimit.ι_desc` and with the manual rewrites at the downstream sites I read.

findings.excerpt:
theorem colimit_ι_nativeGlobalSectionsComparison (i : J) :
    colimit.ι (N.rightOp ⋙ SheafedSpace.Γ) i ≫
        nativeGlobalSectionsComparison N c hc =
findings.problem: This is the `ι_desc`-style leg lemma for the new comparison morphism, which is a `colimit.desc`. It is the only rewrite that reduces `colimit.ι _ i ≫ nativeGlobalSectionsComparison …` to a stage projection. It has no `@[reassoc (attr := simp)]`, unlike Mathlib's `colimit.ι_desc`. The `reassoc` form is also missing, so the lemma cannot fire inside longer composites. Downstream users therefore rewrite by hand and first reassociate with `← Category.assoc`. This happens in NativeCylinderComparison (`rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, SheafedSpace.colimit_ι_nativeGlobalSectionsComparison]`), in NativeSpectralCylinderSections (lines 68-70), and in the `rw [colimit_ι_nativeGlobalSectionsComparison N c hc i]` calls in NativeCommRingGlobalSections and NativeAdditiveGlobalSections. The lemma's own proof also needs `simpa only [nativeGlobalSectionsComparison, nativeGlobalSectionsCocone]` to unfold the definitions by hand.
findings.proposed_change: Mark the lemma `@[reassoc (attr := simp)]`, as Mathlib does for `colimit.ι_desc`. The RHS `SheafedSpace.Γ.map (… .π.app (op i)).op` is strictly more primitive than the LHS, so there is no cycle and no expansion. The `reassoc` version lets `colimit.ι S i ≫ comparison ≫ f` rewrite without `← Category.assoc`. Optionally, add `@[simps]` to `nativeGlobalSectionsCocone` so that `ι_app` and `pt` are available to simp. That would let the proof use `colimit.ι_desc` through simp instead of unfolding by hand.
findings.benefit: Downstream proofs can use `simp [..]` or `rw [colimit_ι_nativeGlobalSectionsComparison_assoc]` directly. This removes the repeated `← Category.assoc` boilerplate in the NativeCylinder and NativeSpectralCylinder proofs. The comparison also gets the same simp interface as every other `colimit.desc` morphism in the library.
